note: THE FIRST TOWN'S DECLARED PAYLOAD, by family. One source for the gate (scripts/first-town-payload.mjs, which sums each family's files in dist/) and for the game (src/assets/AdvanceStream.ts reads saveDataTrim below). WHY IT EXISTS: F-BUDGET-4 — the released gate measured a browser race, not a payload (21.6 / 10.5 / 21.6 MB on one fixed build), so what the town DECLARES had to become data. A family here is the hashed basename with the build hash, the -diet- content hash and any -rNcM sheet cell stripped, exactly as scripts/first-town-request-families.test.mjs derives it. ADD A ROW IN THE SAME COMMIT AS THE CHANGE THAT INTRODUCES THE ASSET; a family in dist that nothing here names is invisible to the gate, and a family named here that dist does not emit fails it.
saveDataTrimWhy: The bulk halls the advance stream drops when navigator.connection.saveData is set. src/assets/AdvanceStream.ts builds its townUrls filter from this list; the gate subtracts the same names for its Save Data subtotal, so the metered arm of the game and the metered arm of the budget cannot disagree.

groups.why: The hero slot's DEFAULT clip group (assets/layer-contracts/characters.v2.json clipGroups.default = 'town'; the town declares SPRITE_CLIP_GROUPS.town). The claim group's two sheets are in `excluded` below.

GATED since 2026-09-07 (owner desk answer A11, verbatim: "raise the budget, this is a good size in my opinion, we don't have to go too crazy"): the ten town actors, one sheet each, named by src/town/town-actor-sheets.json and animated by src/town/TownScene.ts applyFullBodyFrame (`-r<row>c<frame>`), so every cell of every sheet is reachable while the player stands in the town. A cell is fetched the first time an actor turns to face that way, never at entry, so this is the UPPER BOUND of the first town, judged against a budget raised from 25,000,000 to 35,000,000 B for exactly this reason. Before the ruling the group was demand-paged and reported, not gated (F-FTP-1).
Single-image plates the town shows: building facades, the cast's portraits (src/town/townsfolk.ts portraitUrl), the hero and prospector stills, the era kit sheet, the menu furniture and the tab icon.
The town's own GLB plan: the plate, the seven halls, the era props and the plaza dressing — src/town/TownTavernPilot.ts townPrefetchUrls(), which is the advance stream's priority-1 town target.
The click's own sound. The music group is deferred (see `excluded`).

The chunks and stylesheets the first town pulls. The browser probe cannot see most of these: vite preview serves them without a content-length, so the cue-window instrument records 25 of them at ZERO bytes (measured, artifacts/first-town-payload-gate/).

excluded.why: The NEXT map, held by the F-BUDGET-3 scene hold; inside the recorded cue window only because that window's end is polled over CDP with ~500 ms of skirt (F-AUDIO-4).
Same as the-claim-terrain.glb — advance-stream residue, not the town's payload.
Deferred music (F-AUDIO-3): held until the scene the player stands in publishes itself playable, and it arrives 26-195 ms after playable.
The deferred loop's own ?url module; leaves with it.
